text:
incident-bot: [ALERT] High error rate + embedding quality degradation on embeddings-service (dedicated eu-west) affecting Newark Financial customer traffic. Trigger: 5xx spike + cosine-sim drift. Paging oncall.

maria_oncall: Acknowledged. I'm on it — will triage. @sre_rotation can you confirm if this is a routing/rate limiter issue or model degradation?

sre_rotation: Seeing elevated 502/504 from embed workers behind pool-eu-02. KV cache misses spiking. Latency  p50 220ms -> 1.6s. Errors concentrated for requests with vector_length > 1024.

maria_oncall: Noted. Scope: initial check shows failure rate ~18% for requests tagged org:NEWARK-FIN (approx 7% overall cluster impact). Affected tenant IDs: NEWARK-FIN, NEWARK-TRADES. Will escalate if more than 30%.

josh_pmo: Heads up for comms: Newark is a high-touch enterprise with scheduled batch ingestion tonight. CSMs need a tailored statement ASAP. @elena_csm please draft.

elena_csm: Draft below for approval — short and specific. "We are experiencing degraded performance for embeddings ingestion and similarity lookups for Newark Financial. Our engineering team is actively mitigating and may route traffic to a verified backup model to restore stability. We will update by EOD with impact and remediation steps. If your team needs prioritized support, contact us via the Newark escalation channel." Thoughts? :thinking_face:

maria_oncall: Good. Add ETA for next update: 30m. Also include workaround: resubmit with batch_size <= 256 to reduce tail errors.

ops_lead: Engineering recommends temporary routing to hosted-embed-v2 (lower-cost variant with higher availability) as fallback. This requires a routing override for org NEWARK-FIN. @eng-runtime can you apply policy and confirm expected RPS headroom?

eng-runtime: We can flip routing via the routing API. Estimated warmup 45s. Command:
```
curl -X POST https://control-plane.internal/v1/routing/override \ 
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" \ 
  -d '{"org":"NEWARK-FIN","route":"hosted-embed-v2","ttl_secs":3600,"force":true}'
```
I will queue the change once we agree.

sre_rotation: Before we flip, we can also restart embed-worker group gw-eu-02 to clear unhealthy kernels — that may restore ~60% of requests. I'm prepping the restart now (rolling, 1 node at a time).

maria_oncall: Ok plan: 1) restart gw-eu-02 rolling (sre) 2) if >10% error persists after 3min, apply routing override to hosted-embed-v2 (eng-runtime) 3) send customer-facing status and escalation note (elena). Update cadence: every 15m or on major change.

elena_csm: Status page / customer note drafts below.

- Status page short: "Degraded embeddings availability for Newark Financial. Engineering investigating. Some requests may experience increased errors or latency. Next update in 30 minutes."

- Customer email snippet: "We are investigating an issue impacting embeddings ingestion and similarity responses for Newark Financial. Our engineers are performing mitigations; a temporary routing to an alternate model may be applied to restore service. We will notify you when normal service resumes and provide corrective actions taken." Please review.

josh_pmo: Add targeted contact routing for escalation: Newark primary SRE oncall (maria_oncall), CSM (elena_csm), Account Exec (josh_pmo). If no response within 10m escalate to ops_lead and cc security@redwood-inference (for audit).

maria_oncall: Rolling restart step 1 completed — node 1 drained and restarted, error rate down to 12%. Continuing.

sre_rotation: Node 2 restart in progress. If after node 3 error rate >10% I recommend we trigger routing override.

eng-runtime: Standby to apply routing override. If you give the go I'll run the curl. Expected client-visible change: slightly different embedding fingerprint but lower error and stable latency.

maria_oncall: Go for override if errors remain >10% after node 3. Will report back in 3m.

incident-bot: [UPDATE] Incident created INC-2026-4998765432. Pager logs archived.

maria_oncall: After rolling restarts error rate stabilizing at 8.5% — under our 10% threshold. Cancel routing override for now. Continuing monitoring. Next update in 15m. :white_check_mark:

elena_csm: Sending staged customer notice now to Newark contacts and updating status page with short copy. I'll keep the enterprise channel updated with full wording used for the notification.

josh_pmo: Good work. Post-incident actions: (1) root cause triage to check kernel OOM in quantized path, (2) add test that simulates long vectors >1024 during staging canary, (3) add Newark-specific SLA note for scheduled ingestion windows.

ops_lead: Agreed. Please capture action items in INC-2026 ticket and assign owners. I'll prepare exec summary for account team.
